english.legislation: Contrary to sections 15(2)(b) and 35(2) of the Food Safety Act 1990.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
No prosecution for an offence under this Act shall be begun after the expiry of (a) three years from the commission of the offence or (b) one year from its discovery by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
